body.text: A day after the Supreme Court passed on reciprocity, an Oklahoma Guard member deployed to Washington faces a D.C. felony for carrying a pistol that is legal at home.

Charged with carrying a pistol without a licence after a traffic stop, per the affidavit quoted by AmmoLand; four outlets; the case is pending. Nothing about carrying across state lines has changed: a home-state right does not travel, and D.C. recognises no out-of-state permits.
